title: Claude Learning Lab
summary: A personal learning repository documenting hands-on experiments with Claude MCP integrations, SKILL.md files, artifacts, and custom FastMCP servers, including a synthetic data generator tool. This MCP server wraps SDV's HMASynthesizer and evaluation functions to train on multi-table CSVs and score synthetic data quality.
